prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide 16:9 ORIGINAL SOULMONSTERS environment concept panorama for PANTANO DO MORMACO, a deep warm wetland in present-day Kronasta. CLEAN 2D MANGA animation background: crisp economical contours, broad flat local colors, ONE hard cel shadow per material, grouped foliage and selective stone/soil marks. No photorealism, 3D rendering, painterly grain or noisy textures. High three-quarter cutaway landscape showing a coherent readable route from foreground entrance to rear quiet guardian lake. Natural volume and atmosphere, not flat paper polygons.
Three connected spaces within one wetland: foreground arrival on firm pale damp soil with a small modern low-impact field station at land edge, cream/navy weatherproof box architecture, one solar panel, folded rescue stretcher, environmental monitoring mast and a simple tiny grey metal boarding landing. Middle sinuously curving channel with opposite banks, a short SUPPORTED pedestrian bridge located at the RIGHT SIDE and a visible optional calm-water boarding route between two small landings. Bridge on real abutments, clear deck above water, not half buried in mud. Dry route curves right across bridge then north toward open basin. Rear large irregular almost-round DEEP GUARDIAN LAKE with a broad dry rim on THREE SIDES and raised grounded earthen terraces, arrival viewing clearing below front bank, no bridge over the guardian lake, no island altar in center. Leave guardian water EMPTY, do not invent or show any creature.
Make water feel genuinely deep: dark petrol green central mass, lighter teal shallows only next to banks, near-bank soil cross section visibly descends from dry ground into lower water, roots gripping banks not floating. A couple thin low warm steam curls rise at far side of lake as restrained clue to Mormaco, not volcanic fumarole field. Distant darker narrow side branch suggests optional dangerous wetland area without forcing main route. Higher shelf beyond water supports sparse reeds and broadleaf trees framing background, all trunks rooted on visible LAND, never decorative trees planted in deep water. Ferns, reeds and moss grouped at margins only, clear walking floors between.
Palette deep petrol water, olive/sage grouped leaves, warm brown earth with broad clay layers, pale sand-toned wet paths, slate roots, modest amber equipment accents. Characteristic roots form large clean arching shapes above soil without becoming a maze. One modest height change on land: 4 broad natural stone steps with supported sides connect arrival rim to upper dry shelf; keep both landings clear, no rock face crossing steps. Ancient subtle masonry fragment with one line-knot diamond motif near rear edge, not giant fantasy temple. This world has modern technology, no rustic settlement, bamboo huts, medieval ruins everywhere or torches. No neon crystals, no skulls, no poisonous sludge, no constant fog hiding support geometry, no tiled green flat water covering ground. Quiet still heat, immense hidden presence implied by open deep lake and scale of shore.
Composition has breathing room, few trees and strong depth, differentiated earth/water surfaces and connected paths. No people closeups, no Soulmonster designs, no HUD, text, labels, watermark or logo. Main lake silhouette and near-bank recession must be obvious even at small scale.
